marketLayer.title: US AI Hardware & Cloud Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Leading US cloud service providers announced increased capital expenditure guidance for AI infrastructure, driving gains across semiconductor and server supply chains.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained hyper-scaler spending extends strong revenue visibility for upstream chip designers and equipment suppliers into the second half of the year.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential power grid capacity bottlenecks and evolving regulatory controls on advanced technology exports.

marketLayer.title: HK-Listed Chinese Internet & Platform Economy
marketLayer.fact: Major Chinese e-commerce and platform operators listed in Hong Kong reported stable GMV growth alongside reduced cross-border fulfillment subsidies.
marketLayer.inference: Platform companies are shifting focus from margin-dilutive user acquisition toward operating efficiency, profit recovery, and share buybacks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Trajectory of mainland retail sales recovery and broader domestic consumer spending confidence.

marketLayer.title: US Monetary Policy & Capital Flows
marketLayer.fact: Latest US inflation metrics aligned with consensus, sustaining market expectations for an impending interest rate cut cycle by the Federal Reserve.
marketLayer.inference: A easing yield environment supports valuation multiples for high-growth tech stocks and enhances international capital allocation into HK-listed Chinese assets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Unexpected labor market re-tightening or commodity price shocks reigniting inflation pressures.

marketLayer.title: HK Banking & Local Property Sector
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong interbank offered rates (HIBOR) softened across key tenors, while primary market residential mortgage inquiries recorded a steady uptick.
marketLayer.inference: Gradual reduction in local borrowing costs provides marginal relief to real estate developers and supports credit quality for Hong Kong banking institutions.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Refinancing exposure in commercial real estate portfolios and the pace of office rental recovery.
